worldcombat.skill.icebeam.summary: Compress the cold into a straight beam that instantly pierces the whole aim line: each enemy it passes takes Ice damage with a chance to freeze, and the ground is left with a slippery line of ice. Focus narrows it into a heavier beam; spread widens it and reaches further.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.use.0: Pierce enemies lined up in a row
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.use.1: Pick off a distant high-value target
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.use.2: Lay a slippery line of ice along a corridor
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.description.0: Instantly pierces along the aim line: each enemy hit takes about %1$s damage. The beam lingers %2$s, and while pierce slots remain it sweeps the lane again during that time to catch enemies entering its path.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.description.1: Beam length %1$s blocks and half width %2$s blocks; it pierces up to %3$s enemies from nearest outward, each only once.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.description.2: Each target hit has a %1$s chance to be frozen; while frozen it cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks and cannot move, Ice types are immune, and Fire damage thaws it.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.focus.on: Focus mode now: a narrower, shorter beam with higher single-target power and freeze chance, but it pierces only two targets and takes longer to wind up and recharge.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.focus.off: Spread mode now: a wider, longer beam that pierces more targets, but each target takes less, and it winds up and recharges sooner.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.growth.1: From level %1$s power %2$s and beam length %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.preference.foc: On: a narrower, shorter beam with x1.12 power and x1.25 freeze chance, but it pierces only 2 targets and adds +3 windup and +6 cooldown. Off: spread, wider and longer, piercing 3-5 targets, but each target takes a lighter hit.
The companion only considers Ice Beam while a target is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it close, larger starts sooner.
When on, the companion prefers targets with other foes lined up behind them (the beam pierces through); off ranks only by range and target health.
worldcombat.skill.icebeam.description.ri: The beam also lays a slippery line of ice on the ground along its path, up to %2$s blocks, lasting %1$s; it is slick to walk on, and the original blocks return when it expires.
